_comment: 3단계 출력 형식 (rules/script_grammar.md). 줄 예시는 Shopee POC V1 대본에서 가져옴. type은 화면 유형 코드, 'V/O:'로 시작하면 화면 밖 목소리.

lines.text: Today it's all about Prime Primer — and the whole line is fifty percent off, with a free gift!
lines.gesture: One open palm presents to her side.

lines.text: Next, Prime Primer Classic. This is a cream primer, and it is the step right before your foundation.
Just one pea-sized drop. Press it in. See? The skin texture looks smoother, and pores look less visible.
lines.gesture: She points down-right toward the bottom of the frame.
lines.note: 외관 표현만. 모공 면적 수치 미사용

lines.text: V/O: Pea-size, press, wait a moment, then your base.
